text: Went to tutoring for the first time. Calc feels less impossible.
Brought my lab partner to game night. We stayed two hours.
Ate lunch on campus instead of in my car. Small thing, felt good.
Finally made a budget. It's ugly but it's mine.
Did chair yoga between classes. My shoulders forgot they were stressed.
Asked a question in office hours. Nobody laughed.
Went to the resume drop-in. Left with an actual resume.
Slept before midnight three nights in a row for Sleep Week.
Went to the interfaith lunch alone. Left with two names in my phone.
Used the food pantry for the first time. Wish I'd gone sooner.
Joined pickup basketball. I'm bad. It was great.
Volunteered at the campus garden. Turns out dirt is calming.
Talked to someone at CAPS. Glad I did.
Studied in the library with free coffee instead of my room. Got way more done.
Told my roommate I was having a rough week. So was she.
Went to my first club meeting. Already in the group chat.
Walked to class instead of driving around for parking. Twice.
Did the two-minute breathing thing before my exam. Helped more than I expected.
Cooked a real dinner with my suite. Four dollars each.
Retook the inventory. My social score went up. Didn't expect that.
